text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"pounds","kind":"count","span":"can mine 12 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"twice as much with an iron pickaxe"},{"id":"q3","value":50,"unit":"percent","kind":"count","span":"50% more with a steel pickaxe than with an iron pickaxe"},{"id":"q4","value":40,"unit":"dwarves","kind":"count","span":"40 dwarves with steel pickaxes"},{"id":"q5","value":30,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"a month with 30 days"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"bare-hand rate times 2 (twice as much) gives the iron pickaxe rate"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"relates the iron pickaxe rate to the 50 percentage figure representing 'steel is 50% more than iron' (symbolic, not a literal multiplication by 50)"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"steel pickaxe daily rate times number of dwarves gives total ore mined per day by all dwarves"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"total daily ore times number of days in the month gives total ore mined in the month"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total pounds of ore 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes can mine in a 30-day month"},"dismissed":[]}
